domainSeparationConfirm.title: Save separated-domain settings?
domainSeparationConfirm.description:
After saving, the admin URL serves the admin UI and API, while the image, video and file URLs serve only their corresponding media links. Access via IP, an unlisted Host, or a reverse proxy that does not forward Host correctly may lock you out of the admin UI.

If locked out, run docker exec pichost clear-domains (local dev: npm run clear-domains), or disable domain separation in Settings when you can access it again.

Save anyway?
